fixes.issue: Long-form deck risked overflow on narrow viewports
fixes.action: Added max-width 720px and responsive font-size step at 600px breakpoint; hero h1 drops to 30px on mobile.

fixes.issue: 4-column grid would crush KPI numbers on phones
fixes.action: Set grid-template-columns to repeat(2, 1fr) under 600px so each KPI keeps a readable footprint.

fixes.issue: Vega-Lite charts with width=container can clip species labels on small screens
fixes.action: Wrapped chart divs with overflow-x: auto so long bar charts can scroll horizontally rather than truncate.

fixes.issue: Leaflet container needs an explicit height; default 0 leaves the map invisible
fixes.action: Set #map_geo height: 460px and disabled scrollWheelZoom so the page itself scrolls when readers reach the map.

fixes.issue: Hero image width could exceed wrap padding on wide displays
fixes.action: Hero image kept at full-bleed 1080px max-width outside the wrap; in-flow figures cap at 760px to align with body text.
Added border-top 2px solid var(--ink) and 56px top margin per h2 so each numbered section feels like a chapter.

fixes.issue: 22 year ticks risk overlap on narrow viewport
fixes.action: Forced labelAngle 0 and labelFontSize 10 so the dense year axis stays legible without rotation.

notes: All charts use width:container so they re-flow with the wrap. The 5° grid map plots cell centres (SW corner + 2.5°). Behaviour heatmap text colour switches at pct>30 to keep contrast on the darker orange cells.
